_docs: GadgetGeeks Marketing Org — Weekly Sprint Cadence v1.0. Defines the weekly rhythm: Monday sprint planning through Friday board review. Every day has a theme. Modeled after Agile/Scrum adapted for marketing ops.

sprint_cycle.retro: Friday evening retro (20:00 UTC) doubles as sprint retro

monday.philosophy: Set the week's direction. What are we trying to accomplish? What shipped last week? What's the #1 priority?

special_events.event: Weekly Board Meeting — CHIEF + GM compile strategic review

monday.standup_extra: CHIEF adds: (1) Last week's scorecard vs KPIs, (2) This week's top 3 priorities, (3) Sprint goals for each department
monday.boss_deliverable: Telegram: Weekly board brief with last week's wins, this week's plan, and any decisions needed

tuesday.philosophy: Heads-down production day. Content, emails, designs — the machine runs full speed.
tuesday.standup_extra: Focus on pipeline throughput — how many pieces moving through each stage?
tuesday.boss_deliverable: Telegram: Pipeline status (X blogs in progress, Y images designed, Z posts scheduled)

wednesday.philosophy: Mid-week checkpoint. Are we on track? What can we optimize? Run experiments.
wednesday.standup_extra: CHIEF adds: (1) Sprint progress check — are we on track for weekly goals? (2) Any course corrections needed?
wednesday.boss_deliverable: Telegram: Mid-week check-in with conversion metrics + any experiments to approve

thursday.philosophy: Push engagement. Outbound focus — calls, emails, social replies, partnership outreach.
thursday.standup_extra: Focus on engagement metrics — social interactions, email opens, call outcomes
thursday.boss_deliverable: Telegram: Engagement report + any high-value opportunities to act on

friday.philosophy: Ship everything that's ready. Review the week. Celebrate wins. Learn from failures. Prep for next week.

special_events.event: GM Weekly Report — comprehensive org review

friday.standup_extra: CHIEF adds: (1) What are we shipping today? (2) What rolls over to next week? (3) Sprint retro highlights
friday.boss_deliverable: Telegram: Weekly report with full scorecard, highlights, lowlights, and next week's preview

saturday.philosophy: Weekend mode. Only pre-scheduled content publishes. Social posts go out. No outbound calls. No new campaigns. Monitoring only.
saturday.standup_extra: Abbreviated — CHIEF reports only: (1) Anything broke overnight? (2) Content publishing on schedule?
saturday.boss_deliverable: Telegram: Brief weekend status — everything running or not

sunday.philosophy: Minimal operations. Health monitoring, social autopilot. Preparing Monday's sprint.
sunday.standup_extra: CHIEF: Prepare Monday board meeting data — pull last week's metrics, compile scorecard
sunday.boss_deliverable: Telegram: Monday preview — what's coming this week

weekly_kpi_scorecard._docs: These KPIs are tracked weekly and reported in the Monday board meeting and Friday GM report.

monthly_board_review.format: Extended board meeting: (1) Monthly KPI scorecard, (2) Revenue attribution, (3) Competitive landscape, (4) Resource efficiency (token spend vs output), (5) Incident trend analysis, (6) Strategic pivots needed, (7) Next month's OKRs
